बॉलीवु़ड के गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम मसालेदार खबर! 🔥
रामायण फिल्म से रकुल प्रीत सिंह का शूर्पणखा के रूप में पहला लुक मेकर्स ने जारी कर दिया है। 🎬
इस बड़े प्रोजेक्ट के मेकर्स ने पोस्टर शेयर करते हुए लिखा है कि जानस्थान की राजकुमारी शूर्पणखा, रकुल प्रीत सिंह। ✨
रकुल इस फर्स्ट लुक में रॉयल आउटफिट, भारी सोने के गहने और एक शानदार हेडपीस में नजर आ रही हैं। 👑
रकुल का कहना है कि नमित मल्होत्रा की रामायण का हिस्सा बनना और शूर्पणखा का किरदार निभाना उनके लिए एक बेहद खास अनुभव है। 😍
इस फिल्म का निर्देशन Nitesh Tiwari कर रहे हैं और इसे Nitesh Tiwari तथा Namit Malhotra की तरफ से दो-पार्ट में बनाया जा रहा है। 🎥
फिल्म Ramayana: Part 1 को दुनिया भर में 5 नवंबर 2026 को रिलीज किया जाएगा और Part 2 को दिवाली 2027 में लाया जाएगा। 🗓️
बता दें कि इस फिल्म में Ranbir Kapoor भगवान राम के रूप में, Sai Pallavi सीता के रूप में और Yash रावण के रोल में नजर आएंगे। 🌟
क्या आप बड़े पर्दे पर इस भव्य रामायण को देखने के लिए बेताब हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

The Nitesh Tiwari directorial features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana.
The makers of Namit Malhotra’s Ramayana have unveiled the first look of Rakul Preet Singh as Surpanakha, introducing another significant character from the Indian epic. The newly released poster presents the actor as the Princess of Janasthan, offering audiences a glimpse of her appearance in the ambitious two-part cinematic adaptation.
Sharing the poster, the makers captioned it, “Jansthan ki Rajkumari, Surpanakha. Rakul Preet Singh as Surpanakha,” confirming her casting in the role. In the first look, Rakul appears in a royal ensemble featuring intricate detailing, ornate gold jewellery and an elaborate headpiece, reflecting the visual design created for the character.
Speaking about her association with the project, Rakul said, “Being a part of Namit Malhotra’s Ramayana and playing Surpanakha is a truly special experience for me. She is a character with a significant place in this epic, and exploring her world has been an incredible journey as an actor. To be part of a story that has been cherished across generations and holds such a special place in our culture is a privilege. I’m excited for audiences to see this portrayal and experience the world that Nitesh Tiwari and Namit Malhotra are bringing to life on such a grand scale.”
A post shared by The World Of Ramayana (@worldoframayana)
In the Ramayana , Surpanakha is Ravana’s sister, whose encounter with Rama and Lakshman during their exile becomes a pivotal event in the narrative. The episode sets in motion a chain of events that eventually leads to the conflict between Rama and Ravana, making her an important character in the epic’s larger storyline.
The film features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the project is produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations.
Planned as a two-part epic, Ramayana: Part 1 is scheduled to release worldwide on November 5, 2026, with Part 2 slated for Diwali 2027. The films will release in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam, with an IMAX release planned. Sony Pictures will handle international distribution outside India, while Dharma Productions will distribute the film in the Hindi-speaking market.
